artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture on the fingers holding the muzzle appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking natural pore detail or fine wrinkles. The boundary between the thumb and the dog's fur shows slight blending/softness.

The interaction between the hand and the dog's nose/muzzle looks slightly unnatural. The nose tip appears somewhat flattened or merged with the fingers rather than being distinctly pressed against them. The lighting on the nose lacks sharp specular highlights expected on wet nose leather.
The vertical line of the door/frame on the right seems to curve slightly inward, suggesting minor lens distortion or AI warping, though it could also be photographic lens effect.
